2120863896936260037.en_summary: Senate Republican threatens to subpoena Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Sen. Kevin Cramer says $NVDA CEO Jensen Huang should step down, citing national security and potential Chinese blackmail risks, and would support a subpoena if Huang refuses to testify. He also backs tighter AI chip export controls.
2120863896936260037.zh_summary: 參議院共和黨人威脅傳喚 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang。參議員 Kevin Cramer 表示 $NVDA CEO Jensen Huang 應辭職，理由是國家安全和潛在的中國勒索風險，並表示如果 Huang 拒絕作證，他願意支持傳喚。他也支持更嚴格的 AI 晶片出口管制。

2120863544837365814.en_summary: Comment to @romanchernin understanding the shift to providing revenue and earnings guidance for $NBIS, but providing the full capex number while no longer providing the full ARR guide significantly impairs understanding of the scale for those not deeply knowledgeable on the Nebius buildout and financials. Asks to reconsider releasing the 2027 ARR guide on the call.
2120863544837365814.zh_summary: 對 @romanchernin 的評論，理解轉向提供收入和盈利指引以讓傳統投資者理解 $NBIS，但提供完整資本支出數字而不再提供完整 ARR 指引，顯著妨礙了對規模的理解。要求重新考慮在電話會議上發布 2027 年 ARR 指引。

2120860456940101828.en_summary: $LUNR / $RKLB: Intuitive Machines out-earned Rocket Lab in Q3 with $269M revenue and $2.8B market cap versus Rocket Lab's $268M revenue and $39.6B market cap. Same quarterly revenue at about 7% of the market cap. LUNR was positive on adjusted EBITDA ($8.3M). Rocket Lab has bigger backlog $3.6B vs $1.87B and Neutron, but that's a 14x valuation gap on the same top line.
2120860456940101828.zh_summary: $LUNR / $RKLB：Intuitive Machines 在 Q3 收入超過 Rocket Lab，收入 2.69 億美元、市值 28 億美元，對比 Rocket Lab 的 2.68 億美元收入和 396 億美元市值。相同季度收入僅約市值的 7%。LUNR 調整後 EBITDA 為正 (830 萬美元)。Rocket Lab 有更大的積壓訂單 36 億對 18.7 億和 Neutron，但相同頂線有 14 倍估值差距。

ticker_notes.LUNR: similar revenue to RKLB at much lower market cap, positive adjusted EBITDA
